suggestions.quote: you did not buy ten years with him; you bought ten years he may have without you
suggestions.fix: If this is narrated, it explains what the bench picture already shows (the same age, the wristband) and reads like an essay. Say it as a short, hushed, complete line over the wordless peak: "Ten years. For him. Not with him." Or leave it unsaid and let the wristband carry it.

suggestions.quote: One year from me buys him ten. Good deal.
suggestions.fix: Give it the direction 'dry, a little pleased with yourself', so it can turn bitter when it returns. Say "Good deal" with the same stress both times, and let the last line mirror its dryness.

suggestions.quote: You price his bill in internship hours, the way you price the bus.
suggestions.fix: Direction 'hushed, matter-of-fact'. Split it for the breath at 1.1x: "His bill. In internship hours. The way you price the bus." Speak the title question in the first 3 seconds, as 'curious'.

suggestions.quote: the idea room cites 55 million a year
suggestions.fix: Add to say.yaml: 55 million -> "fifty-five million". Also "lakh" -> "lakh" (stress on 'lakh') and "crore" -> "crore". Any surgery cost in hours is spoken as "about four hundred hours" style words, with the digit cited to its claims.md row.

suggestions.quote: he has seen the app, and refuses to let you pay for his medicine
suggestions.fix: Papa speaks only in bubbles of four words or fewer: use "Keep your years, beta." (four words). Have Arthur follow with one warm, quiet fragment such as "He knew. Of course he knew." rather than a narrated explanation.

suggestions.quote: You expected to look distinguished; you got your grandfather's eyebrow.
suggestions.fix: This is the right gap but runs long for one breath. Speak it as "You wanted distinguished. You got one grandfather eyebrow." Direction 'amused'.

suggestions.quote: you sit the exam older than the invigilator
suggestions.fix: Keep the joke, but speak it as a fragment with a beat after it: "Older than the invigilator." Direction 'wry', with a short breath before the pharmacy bill turns it cold.

keep.quote: He's teasing you about the bus pass again. You let him.
One year from me buys him ten. Good deal.
